clips.title: The story
paras: In Brill, Austil de Mon sends fighters to Deathguard Dillinger for a hazardous mission in service of Lady Sylvanas. The order begins at the Gallows' End Tavern, where the warrior trainer directs able-bodied recruits to the west end of the village.

At the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, warrior trainer Austil de Mon seeks fighters willing to serve the Dark Lady. When the Deathguards need capable hands, he sends untested recruits into the field. Deathguard Dillinger oversees security on Brill's western edge and has requested someone with martial skill for an urgent task.

The Forsaken must constantly prove their martial dominance on Tirisfal Glades' front line. Near Brill's graveyard, Dillinger manages local incursions. Reporting to him tests your combat skill and loyalty to the newly forged Forsaken nation.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was told Deathguard Dillinger has a job for someone like you. If you're willing to show your value to the Dark Lady's forces, then report to Dillinger immediately.
Deathguard Dillinger's post is on the west end of Brill, near the graveyard.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You're here for a mission? Good. I have an important one, and one that will test your skill in combat... And your resolve in the defense of the Forsaken.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
